title: Find Your Trading Style
subtitle: Ten ways to trade the same chart. The right one depends on your time, temperament and goals — not on which looks cleverest.
outroLine: There is only the one you can run for years without burning out. Pick for your life, not for the chart.
footer: Simulated charts, not real market data · Educational only — not financial advice · DYOR

styles.name: SCALPING
styles.oneLiner: High-frequency trades capturing small price moves.
bullets: Dozens of trades executed per session
Tight stop-losses, small profit targets
styles.demands: Constant screen focus, low-latency tools, fees erode gains

styles.name: DAY TRADING
styles.oneLiner: Positions opened and closed within a single session.
bullets: Trades held minutes to hours, not overnight
Entries based on intraday chart patterns
styles.demands: Full trading-day attention; US PDT rule needs $25k equity

styles.name: SWING TRADING
styles.oneLiner: Trades multi-day price swings, not single ticks.
bullets: Trades held for days across swing legs
Position sized to absorb overnight gaps
styles.demands: Requires patience through pullbacks; moderate screen time

styles.name: POSITION TRADING
styles.oneLiner: Holds trades for weeks to months, riding trends.
bullets: Entries based on daily to monthly charts
Few trades taken across a full year
styles.demands: Ties up capital for months; needs strong conviction

styles.name: TREND TRADING
styles.oneLiner: Stay in a trend until price structure breaks down
bullets: Enter with the trend, add on pullbacks
Trail stops instead of fixing a target
styles.demands: Requires patience through drawdowns and choppy pullbacks

styles.name: BREAKOUT TRADING
styles.oneLiner: Enter when price breaks out of a tight range
bullets: Trades a range breakout, not a trend
Exit fast if price re-enters the range
styles.demands: Needs fast execution and strict stops to avoid false breaks

styles.name: RANGE TRADING
styles.oneLiner: Buying support, selling resistance in a range
bullets: Enters near support, exits near resistance
Fails when price breaks the range
styles.demands: Demands frequent monitoring and discipline near range edges

styles.name: NEWS TRADING
styles.oneLiner: Trading the price reaction to a scheduled news event
bullets: Positions taken just before the release
Exits within minutes as volatility fades
styles.demands: Needs fast feeds, low latency, and tolerance for slippage

styles.name: ALGORITHMIC
styles.oneLiner: A coded rule set trades the market without hands.
bullets: Code defines entries, exits, position size
Runs on backtested, unattended logic
styles.demands: Requires coding skill, infrastructure, constant oversight

styles.name: PORTFOLIO / SIZING
styles.oneLiner: Capital allocation and sizing across holdings.
bullets: Weights and rebalances across positions
Shifts exposure between sectors over time
styles.demands: Needs discipline, diversification, patience over months

microrange.note: range compresses; the edge is frequency, not distance

intraday-session.note: one session, opened and closed inside it

swing-leg.note: one leg, held across the noise inside it

sustained-trend.note: higher highs and higher lows, still intact

consolidation-break.note: contained, then a CLOSE beyond the box

event-gap.note: range expands the instant the print lands

systematic.note: one rule, fired every time it triggered
